label: Respondent sequence number
notes: Merge key. Each file has one row per SEQN. DEMO_L has every participant; BPXO_L and BPQ_L have fewer rows.

label: Interview/Examination status
allowed_values: 1 = Interviewed only; 2 = Both interviewed and MEC examined
notes: Blood pressure was measured only in the mobile examination center (MEC).

label: Age in years at screening
allowed_values: 0 to 79; 80 = 80 years of age and over
notes: Top-coded: 80 means 80 or older. CDC says the weighted mean age of this group is 85.

label: Race/Hispanic origin w/ NH Asian
allowed_values: 1 = Mexican American; 2 = Other Hispanic; 3 = Non-Hispanic White; 4 = Non-Hispanic Black; 6 = Non-Hispanic Asian; 7 = Other Race - Including Multi-Racial

label: Pregnancy status at exam
allowed_values: 1 = Yes (positive lab pregnancy test or self-reported pregnant at exam); 2 = The participant was not pregnant at exam; 3 = Cannot ascertain if the participant is pregnant at exam
skip_logic: Released only for females age 20-44 at the MEC exam. Blank for everyone else (all males and females of other ages) and for people not examined.
notes: Most adults are blank here. A blank does not mean pregnant.

label: Full sample 2-year interview weight
notes: Interview weight. Not for analyses that use exam data such as blood pressure; use WTMEC2YR.

label: Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight
notes: Exam weight. The 3073 people interviewed but not examined have 0.

label: Masked variance pseudo-PSU
notes: Survey design variable for variance estimation (PSU = primary sampling unit). Nested within SDMVSTRA.

label: Masked variance pseudo-stratum
notes: Survey design variable for variance estimation (15 strata).

label: Systolic - 1st oscillometric reading
skip_logic: Measured in the MEC for participants age 8 and older.
notes: Three readings taken 60 seconds apart after 5 minutes of seated rest.

label: Diastolic - 1st oscillometric reading
skip_logic: Measured in the MEC for participants age 8 and older. No diastolic value without a systolic value.

label: Systolic - 2nd oscillometric reading
skip_logic: Measured in the MEC for participants age 8 and older.

label: Diastolic - 2nd oscillometric reading
skip_logic: Measured in the MEC for participants age 8 and older. No diastolic value without a systolic value.

label: Systolic - 3rd oscillometric reading
skip_logic: Measured in the MEC for participants age 8 and older.

label: Diastolic - 3rd oscillometric reading
skip_logic: Measured in the MEC for participants age 8 and older. No diastolic value without a systolic value.

label: Ever told you had high blood pressure
skip_logic: Asked of participants age 16 and older. If 2 (No) or 7 or 9: skip to BPQ080 so BPQ150 is not asked.
notes: Question: ever told by a doctor or other health professional that you had hypertension, also called high blood pressure?

label: Taking high blood pressure medication
skip_logic: Asked only if BPQ020 = 1. Blank when BPQ020 is 2 or 7 or 9 or blank.
notes: Question: now taking any medication prescribed by a doctor for high blood pressure? Replaces BPQ050A from earlier NHANES cycles.
